name: gap_reversal_volume_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY opens with an overnight gap (>0.3%), the first 1-2 minutes of 5-second bars reveal institutional contra-positioning through volume microstructure: if NIFTY gapped down yet most 5-second bars in the opening minute close above their opens (positive cumulative bar pressure), and session OBV is rising despite the gap-down price, VWAP-benchmarked institutional buyers are accumulating aggressively at sub-benchmark prices. This contra-volume signal — buying into a gap-down, or selling into a gap-up — precedes price reversal by 60-90 seconds as institutional flows progressively overwhelm gap-direction momentum. We enter when bar pressure plus rising OBV both confirm the contra-flow, while price remains on the wrong side of VWAP (confirming the reversal has not yet been fully priced in), targeting the initial 60-120 second thrust back toward session VWAP. This is fundamentally different from price-only gap fade strategies: we require volume-confirmed institutional positioning before entry.
trades_per_day: 1-3 (only on gap days, opening hour only)

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Day-level overnight gap magnitude. No bar-period scaling — this is a session-level reference. Threshold 0.3% filters noise from genuine institutional-positioning gaps. Above 1.5% we also filter because extreme gaps are news-driven and less likely to reverse on institutional flows alone.

indicators.name: bar_pressure_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute (12 bars × 5s) normalized bar pressure: proxy for buy/sell imbalance replacing tick-level classification from original. Each 5-second bar's (close - open) sign gives direction of intra-bar pressure. Rolling 12-bar sum measures whether net flow opposes the gap direction. 12 bars chosen because 1 minute is the minimum confirmation window that reduces false signals while remaining actionable for 30-120s holds. Shorter (6 bars = 30s) is too noisy; longer (24 bars = 2 min) entry is too slow relative to the hold window.

indicators.name: obv_session
indicators.formula: cumulative OBV from 09:15, reset each session day
indicators.purpose: Session OBV accumulates net volume flow direction. Rising OBV during gap-down = accumulation (buyers absorbing supply). Slope over 12 bars (1 min) separates acceleration from mean reversion. Cumulative measure; no bar-period scaling needed.

indicators.name: obv_slope_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute OBV directional rate of change. Positive = accumulation (buying into gap-down); negative = distribution (selling into gap-up). Normalized by OBV level to make comparable across days. Same 12-bar window as bar_pressure_12 for consistency of signal confirmation window.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumulative sum(typical_price * volume) / cumulative sum(volume) from 09:15
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP as the mean-reversion anchor. For a gap-down reversal entry, price must be BELOW VWAP (confirming reversal has not yet completed). This filters late entries where the gap has already partially or fully filled. Cumulative measure; no scaling needed.

conditions: gap_pct > -0.015 (not an extreme gap >1.5% which is news-driven)
bar_pressure_12 > pressure_threshold (net buying in last 12 bars despite gap-down)
close < vwap (price still below VWAP — reversal not yet priced in)
bars_since_open >= 12 (at least 1 minute of session data)
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions met simultaneously on same 5-second bar

conditions: bar_pressure_12 < -pressure_threshold (net selling in last 12 bars despite gap-up)
close > vwap (price still above VWAP — reversal not yet priced in)
bars_since_open >= 12 (at least 1 minute of session data)
buy_pe.confirmation: All conditions met simultaneously on same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot points at ATM delta ~0.5). If after entry the gap extends 8+ spot points further in the gap direction, the institutional contra-flow thesis has failed — the volume signal was noise, not genuine accumulation. NIFTY 5-minute moves average 7-15 spot pts; a continued 8-pt adverse move in 60s confirms the gap is structural, not behavioral. Tighter than v103/large_v1 stops because this entry comes later (after volume confirmation), so the reversal should start quickly or not at all.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points (~14 NIFTY spot points). For moderate gaps (0.3-0.7% = 60-140 NIFTY pts), the first reversal leg typically covers 20-40% of the gap, which for a 0.3% gap is ~15-20 spot points. We target 14 spot pts, capturing the initial thrust at roughly 50% of the expected first leg. At 2-minute holds, NIFTY typical move is 5-10 option pts; 7 pts is within the upper range, giving 1:1.75 risk-reward.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 20 (extreme volatility means gaps are structural news gaps, not behavioral — contra-volume thesis breaks down above VIX 20)
filters.time_filter: 09:20-10:00 IST only — gap reversals are opening-hour phenomena; after 45 minutes the remaining gap is structural
filters.trend_filter: abs(gap_pct) < 0.015 filters extreme news-driven gaps where institutional positioning is uncertain

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — bar pressure (close vs open) is a noisy proxy for tick-level buy/sell classification; the original's advantage came from true Lee-Ready classification which 5-second bars cannot replicate exactly. Volume imbalance signal quality is degraded compared to tick data.

adaptation_notes: Four key changes from original: (1) UNIVERSE: changed from NIFTY 50 constituent stocks to NIFTY index itself — index gaps are driven by SGX Nifty futures and global equity moves, same contra-positioning thesis applies at index level; (2) VOLUME PROXY: replaced tick-level buy/sell classification (unavailable on 5s bars) with normalized 5-second bar pressure (close > open = buying; close < open = selling) — noisier but directionally correct at 12-bar aggregation; (3) HOLD TIME: compressed from 30-120 minutes to 30-120 seconds — we capture only the initial reversal thrust, not the full gap fill; target changed from prev_close to 14 spot pts (~35% of a typical 0.4% gap); (4) DIFFERENTIATED FROM EXISTING: gap_fade_reversion_v103 uses price-only (first 5 bars); gap_fade_large_v1 uses RSI extremes; this strategy enters LATER (after volume confirmation) and uses OBV + bar pressure as the primary signal. The delayed entry means this strategy often fires 2-5 minutes after the gap, when institutional contra-flow is confirmed rather than anticipated.
weaknesses: 5-second bar close vs open is a crude proxy for tick-level buy/sell classification — Lee-Ready algorithm correctly classifies ~80-85% of trades, bar pressure correctly identifies direction ~65-70% of trades, significantly weaker signal
Only trades on gap days (0.3-1.5% gap range) — occurs 30-40% of sessions, meaning 60-70% of days produce zero signals
Three other gap strategies already exist in the pipeline (gap_fade_reversion_v103, gap_fade_large_v1, gap_fill_full_v1) — correlated losses on the same gap days
Late entry (after 09:20 + 12-bar confirmation) means fast-filling gaps may already be 20-40% reversed before signal fires, reducing the remaining target

_source.original_stop: 0.6 * ATR_14 or new intraday extreme in gap direction
